 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Spanish national team have confirmed the shirt numbers their players will wear tonight in Prague. The Royal Spanish Football Federation (RFEF) has officially released Spain's squad numbers for their clash with the Czech Republic on matchday five of the UEFA Nations League.
 Luis de la Fuente's side take to the pitch at 20:45 at Letná Stadium. Spain arrive in Central Europe as the outright leaders of Group A3, having won all four of their previous matches.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Among the main talking points is that Víctor Muñoz will wear the iconic number 10 shirt. The goalkeeping numbers, meanwhile, go to David Raya (1), Joan García (13) and Unai Simón (23), while young talents such as Pau Cubarsí (5), Dean Huijsen (4) and Fermín López (9) continue to establish themselves in the squad.
 With their place in the next round already secured, the reigning world champions are looking to clinch top spot in the group. Spain are also aiming to extend their historic unbeaten run in competitive matches to 44 games.
 The clash with the group's bottom side, who have yet to pick up a point, will test Spain's squad depth. In the reverse fixture in Oviedo, Spain cruised to a convincing 3-1 victory.
